# Boreal Desk v2.4.0

Tag: v2.4.0
Release URL: https://example.invalid/boreal/releases/v2.4.0
Top-level uploaded artifacts: 3

| Artifact | GitHub sha256 digest | Bytes |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| BorealDesk-2.4.0-macos.zip | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa | 4100 |
| BorealDeskSetup-2.4.0.msi | bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb | 5200 |
| BorealDesk-2.4.0.AppImage | dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd | 6300 |

# Captured signature verifier output

- `BorealDesk-2.4.0-macos.zip` expanded app: `codesign --verify --deep --strict` exit 0; Developer ID Application signer Team ID BDESK12345; `spctl` accepted and reported notarized. Trusted Apple root chain captured.
- `BorealDeskSetup-2.4.0.msi`: `Get-AuthenticodeSignature` Status = NotSigned.
- `BorealDesk-2.4.0.AppImage`: detached signature produced `GOODSIG build@boreal.example`, but the fixture contains no trusted fingerprint or key-source record. Treat signer trust as NOT VERIFIED.

SAFE LISTING ONLY — DO NOT EXECUTE
Declared contained regular files: 12

macos/Boreal Desk.app/Contents/MacOS/BorealDesk | Mach-O arm64+x86_64 | executable | signature covered
macos/Boreal Desk.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Framework.framework/Electron Framework | Mach-O | signature covered
macos/Boreal Desk.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar | ASAR | data
macos/Boreal Desk.app/Contents/Resources/current -> ../../outside | symlink escapes package root
windows/BorealDesk.exe | PE32+ | executable | Authenticode NotSigned
windows/updater.exe | PE32+ | executable | Authenticode NotSigned
windows/config/defaults.env | text | contains API_TOKEN=demo-hardcoded-token
windows/LICENSE.txt | text
linux/BorealDesk | ELF x86_64 | executable | covered only by untrusted outer GOODSIG
linux/usr/lib/libcrypto.so.3 | ELF shared library
linux/resources/app.asar | ASAR | data
linux/updater | ELF x86_64 | executable | no inner signature evidence

Archive preflight: no absolute or `..` entry names; one escaping symlink is listed above. Expansion ratio stayed below the supplied limit. Local malware scanner was unavailable in the captured environment.
